title: Precision Lithography
description: Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the smallest feature size a lithography lens can print (Rayleigh criterion).

title: Cryogenics
description: Near absolute zero, matter forgets it is many particles. Superfluids and Bose-Einstein condensates.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the best possible coefficient of performance of a refrigerator pulling heat out of liquid helium at Tc and dumping it into a room at Th.

title: Quantum Chemistry
description: Solve the Schrödinger equation for a molecule and you have its chemistry. Unlocks orbital lattices and chiral crystals.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the energy of the n = 2 level of the hydrogen atom from the Schrödinger equation.

title: Extremophiles
description: Life at the edges: boiling vents, frozen vacuum, radiation. Unlocks tardigrade cultures.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the rate constant of an enzyme-catalysed reaction in a hyperthermophile living at 121 °C, using the Arrhenius law.

title: The Platonic Realm
description: If mathematical objects exist somewhere, they exist here. Unlocks the Platonic Compass.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the number of edges of a Platonic solid from its vertices and faces (e.g. the dodecahedron).

title: Femtoengineering
description: Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the photon energy needed to resolve (and engineer) a structure of size d, smaller than a proton.

title: Exotic Chemistry
description: Chemistry with muons, positrons and antimatter instead of electrons. Unlocks positronium hydride and muonic catalysts.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Bohr radius of muonic hydrogen - a muon (mass m) orbiting a proton (mass M) - using the reduced mass.

title: Accelerator Physics
description: Bend a beam with dipoles, focus it with quadrupoles, push it with RF cavities - and keep it all at two kelvin in a perfect vacuum. Unlocks the beamline components and the Hyperion Synchrotron.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the bending radius (m) of a 7000 GeV/c proton beam in 8.33 T dipoles.

title: Artificial General Intelligence
description: A mind that can learn anything.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the output of a sigmoid neuron - the building block of learning machines - with net input z.

title: Psionics
description: Thought, crystallised. A science that should not exist.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the resting (Nernst) potential of a neuron for an ion species - the closest real 'crystallised thought' is the voltage of a nerve cell.

title: The Standard Model
description: Six quarks, six leptons, four gauge bosons and the Higgs. Unlocks the Particle Spectrometer.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the W boson mass from the weak coupling g and the Higgs vacuum expectation value v.

title: Abstract Algebra
description: Quaternions, octonions and spinors: number systems that give up commutativity, then associativity.

old_puzzle.goal: Find how many imaginary units the algebra obtained after n Cayley-Dickson doublings of the reals has (complex, quaternions, octonions...).

title: Compact Stars
description: Neutron stars, magnetars, pulsars and quark stars - the densest objects short of a singularity.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the characteristic (spin-down) age in years of a pulsar with period P and period derivative Pd (the Crab pulsar).

title: The Penrose Process
description: Energy can be stolen from a rotating black hole's ergosphere.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the maximum energy extractable by the Penrose process from a rotating black hole of mass M and horizon area A (units G = c = 1).

title: Category Theory
description: Objects and arrows. Functors between categories, and toposes - universes with their own logic.

old_puzzle.goal: Show how many morphisms A×B → C exist in the category of finite sets by counting maps A → C^B (currying, the exponential adjunction), with |A| = 2, |B| = 3, |C| = 2.

title: Geometric Topology
description: Surfaces with one side and bottles with no inside.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the genus of a closed orientable surface triangulated with V = 10 vertices, E = 36 edges and F = 24 faces.

title: Superintelligence
description: A mind that improves itself. Computronium becomes possible.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the capability of a self-improving mind after n rounds, if each round improves it by a fraction r.

title: Mass Manipulation
description: Massless matter, negative mass and the inertial dampers every starship needs.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the energy (GeV) of a particle with momentum 3 GeV/c and mass 4 GeV/c^2, in units where c = 1 (set m = 0 to see massless matter).

title: Quantum Biology
description: Photosynthesis, enzymes and migrating birds all use quantum coherence. Unlocks quantum chlorophyll and magnetoreceptors.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the probability that an electron tunnels through a 0.3 nm protein barrier with decay constant κ = 10 nm^-1.

title: String Theory
description: Every particle is a vibrating string. Unlocks the String Resonance Loom.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the frequency (Hz) of the 3rd harmonic of a string of length 0.5 m, tension 100 N and linear density 0.01 kg/m - each mode is a different 'particle'.

title: Field Engineering
description: Gravity, dimension, time and the vacuum are all fields - and fields can be projected. Unlocks the Field Projectors, the Graviton Harness and the Chronal Anchor.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the gravitational field strength a projector must reproduce at distance r from a mass M.

title: Grand Unification
description: At high enough energy, three forces become one.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the inverse U(1) coupling at Q = 1e16 GeV, given 1/α = 59 at μ = 91.2 GeV and one-loop coefficient b = 4.1.
old_puzzle.expr: a - b / ( 2 * π ) * ln ( Q / μ )

title: M-Theory
description: Strings are the edges of membranes in eleven dimensions.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the 11-dimensional Planck length of M-theory from the string coupling gs and string length ls.

title: Cosmogenesis
description: False vacuum decay plus inflation equals a new universe. Then harvest it.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the tunnelling exponent B for false vacuum decay in the thin-wall approximation (decay rate ∝ e^-B).

title: Paradox Engineering
description: Russell sets and Banach-Tarski spheres: building with contradictions.

old_puzzle.goal: Show how many reduced words of length n = 5 exist in the free group on two generators, the engine of the Banach-Tarski paradox.

title: The Transfinite Hierarchy
description: Ordinals count past infinity; cardinals measure it. Both have a place of their own - with the objects of higher dimensions. Unlocks the Cantor Key and the Ordinal Recursor.

old_puzzle.goal: Find how many square (2-dimensional) faces an n-dimensional hypercube has (e.g. the tesseract).

title: Abiogenesis
description: Where chemistry becomes life. Unlocks the Abiogenesis Crucible and the Spark of Life.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the longest genome (bases) a replicator can keep without an error catastrophe if its master sequence has selective advantage 10 and per-base copying fidelity 0.99.

title: Pleroma
description: The fullness of everything: every fluid there is, poured together. Unlocks the Pleroma Confluence.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Gibbs energy of mixing (kJ) when one mole each of N = 1000 different ideal fluids is poured together at 300 K.
